name: Laetitia Chardin
original_name: レティシア・シャルダン
source:
At the age of five, she was given a blessing by the Goddess of Spring,
and has been living in the temple in the capital ever since.
She received a divine message from the Goddess of Spring that she would become the "Bride of God."
